definitions.explanation: An extra amount added on top of a base price, fee, or quantity. Used in business, finance, and everyday contexts when something is added to an existing amount.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{上乗|うわの}せ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Add a handling fee on top of the price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧サーチャージ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{航空券|こうくうけん}→航空券：19426_koukuuken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上乗|うわの}せ⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A fuel surcharge is added on top of the airfare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧で、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上乗|うわの}せ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避|さ}けられなく→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to rising raw material costs, adding a few percent to product prices became unavoidable.

notes:
{上乗|うわの}せ is formed from ⟦{上|うわ}→上〜：00416_uwa⟧ (on top) + {乗|の}せ (placing). It describes adding an extra amount to an existing total.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上乗|うわの}せ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to add on, to surcharge)
- ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上乗|うわの}せ (surcharge on fees)
- ⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上乗|うわの}せ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (add to the price)
- {上乗|うわの}せ⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧ (the added amount)
- {上乗|うわの}せ⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (surcharge fee)

USAGE:
- Very common in business and consumer contexts when discussing pricing
- Can also be used beyond money: ⟦{人員|じんいん}→人員：17843_jinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{上乗|うわの}せ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (add extra staff)
- ⟦{追加|ついか}{料金|りょうきん}→追加料金：22313_tsuikaryoukin⟧ (additional fee) is a near-synonym but {上乗|うわの}せ emphasizes the "on top of" aspect
